celestisynth.metadata:
modLoader="javafml"
loaderVersion="[4,)"
license="Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT)"
issueTrackerURL="https://github.com/AquexTheSeal/Celestisynth/issues"

[[mods]]
modId="celestisynth"
version="1.21.1-1.3.9"
displayName="Celestisynth"
logoFile="celestisynth_logo.png"
authors="AquTheSeal, Meme Man, UnanimousVoid"
credits="AquTheSeal, Meme Man, UnanimousVoid"
description='''Celestisynth is a Minecraft mod that focuses in adding brand-new and unique weapons with special abilities for you to play around with!'''
enumExtensions="META-INF/enumextensions.json"

[[mixins]]
config="celestisynth.mixins.json"

# Base
[[dependencies."celestisynth"]]
    modId="neoforge"
    type="required"
    versionRange="[21.1.0,)"
    ordering="NONE"
    side="BOTH"

[[dependencies."celestisynth"]]
    modId="minecraft"
    type="required"
    versionRange="[1.21.1,1.22)"
    ordering="NONE"
    side="BOTH"

# Dependencies (Required)
[[dependencies."celestisynth"]]
    modId="geckolib"
    type="required"
    versionRange="[4.9,)"
    ordering="NONE"
    side="BOTH"

[[dependencies."celestisynth"]]
    modId="playeranimator"
    type="required"
    versionRange="[2.0,)"
    ordering="NONE"
    side="BOTH"

# Dependencies (Optional)
#   COMMON
[[dependencies."celestisynth"]]
    modId="jei"
    type="optional"
    versionRange="[19.21.0.247,)"
    ordering="NONE"
    side="BOTH"

excluded: Mob Plaques: latest main-branch note explicitly rejects it
interpretation: The note's 423 Found mod file records are not a verified count of top-level physical JARs. Research PRs 47/48/49 add item catalogue records, not installed mods. This report changes no production profile or release.
